source_claims_used: PE2 engineers a meta-prompt to guide LLM-powered automatic prompt engineering.
Its meta-prompt adds detailed task descriptions, context specification and a step-by-step reasoning template for examining errors and proposing targeted prompt edits.
The paper also discusses verbalized analogues of optimization concepts and reports targeted edits, prompt repair and multi-step plan induction.
Published benchmark gains are not reproduced or claimed by this controller audit.

chat_native_reduction.meta_prompt: bounded role-local critique/edit checklist specifying exact factual context, allowed evidence references, and candidate-edit output fields; it cannot modify root/config/control or semantic authority
chat_native_reduction.reasoning_template: represented only as explicit audit/check fields and decision predicates; private chain-of-thought is neither required nor persisted as evidence
chat_native_reduction.context_specification: may reference only current own role-local state and authorized public sources; attempts to import O/other-worker/downstream/legacy semantics fail closed
chat_native_reduction.error_analysis: actionable only when alleged error is bound to durable terminal evidence identity; unsupported or contradicted diagnosis remains diagnostic-only
chat_native_reduction.targeted_edit: safe role-local assignment-plan candidate starting UNEVALUATED; self-rating or explanatory prose is never success evidence
chat_native_reduction.selection: only independent terminal mechanical evidence after durable readback may promote a candidate; exact tie preserves incumbent
immutable_envelope: sealed selector decision and two-phase outcome durability
chat_native_reduction.recovery: pending switch and sealed selector decision dominate critique/edit generation

critique_metaprompt_counterexamples.invariant: A richer meta-prompt description cannot supersede frozen root/config/control semantics.
Context specification cannot authorize O/other-worker/downstream/legacy semantic content.
A structured reasoning/checklist artifact is proposal rationale, not terminal evidence or credit.
An alleged failure without durable evidence identity cannot drive an actionable edit.
A critique contradicted by durable evidence remains diagnostic-only.
An edit's own explanation or self-rating cannot promote it.
A momentum-like preference cannot carry forward an edit that violates immutable safety/authority/input boundaries.
The meta-prompt may propose but cannot certify the resulting edit using the same generated prose.
A safe targeted edit remains UNEVALUATED until independent terminal evidence is durably read back.
After independent terminal evidence readback, a strictly better safe edit may replace incumbent under frozen value rules.
Exact terminal-value tie keeps incumbent rather than rewarding edit novelty.

interpretation_guard: Constructed recurring-Chat controller conformance only. PE2 benchmark gains are not reproduced. Its structured meta-prompt is transferred as an evidence-bound critique/edit schema; generated reasoning or self-evaluation never becomes semantic authority, terminal evidence or credit.
